parentReviewBoundary: This file records Luna's evidence-bound self-review. It does not claim 3/3 whole-page acceptance; the parent task remains the final acceptance authority.
limitations: The existing harness validates disjoint rectangular text blocks and structure frames, so it cannot place a criterion directly on a funnel edge or draw a lightweight visual leader between a stage and an external note without a custom page builder.

The preserved folded-note and funnel implementations adapt their internal geometry and padding as a group; the agent can choose the outer frame but cannot independently tighten each internal card or layer.
The remaining P1/P2 issues are page-organization issues in the agent-chosen external text placement, not missing facts or failed structure invocation.

P1: 资料齐全=关键文件集中归档
版本清楚=当前版本标记明确
责任明确=后续负责人可查
例外有据=特殊处理附上依据
主张包含接手者能独立继续工作且发送文件不等于验收
P2: 入口=访谈/工单/使用记录
准入依据=保留原始反馈/问题可重复观察/小样验证有效/责任人与交付范围明确
P3: 1 被动处理=故障后临时组织抢修
2 形成记录=故障原因与处理过程可查
3 计划维护=按周期检查并落实责任
4 持续改善=用复盘减少重复故障
